correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md proves X_k=conv{T_k(P_pi)} via Birkhoff–von Neumann. Each noncentral X-ray h is a nonnegative integer vector of total mass k and coordinate cap k−1, hence ||h||²≤(k−1)²+1 and any noncentral pair lies below squared diameter 2k²−2k+2. Equality with unique central H forces off-center occupancy k−1 and one residual unit, producing only L,U (coinciding for k=2). Strict convexity of squared Euclidean distance excludes new continuum equality pairs. For k≥4, a runner-up h with no central mass has cap k−2, forcing squared norm ≤(k−2)²+4, attained by explicit permutation W; pairs with central mass or without H have smaller distance. Independently enumerated all distinct X-rays and every pair through k=6, including k=2 and k=3 exceptions.
